story.iWant: a service that validates OpenAPI specs before accepting them
story.soThat: only well-formed specs are ingested into the catalog

tasks.task: Install and Configure OpenAPI Validation Library
Write Unit Tests for Validation Service
Create Fastify Plugin for Validation Service
Add Integration Test with Sample Specs

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Service validates JSON structure, OpenAPI version (3.0.x/3.1.x), required fields (openapi, info, paths), paths contains endpoints, valid HTTP methods
Service validates $ref resolution: all refs resolvable, circular refs detected, dereferencing completes
Validation errors return structured response: { valid: false, errors: [{ path, message, code }] }
Valid specs return: { valid: true, dereferenced: bundled_spec }
$refs resolved recursively and bundled into single spec before storage
Limits enforced: Max spec size 10MB, Max endpoints per spec 1000
Validation service exported for use in other modules via Fastify plugin
Comprehensive error messages guide users to fix validation issues

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: Validates OpenAPI specs before ingestion to ensure only well-formed specs enter the catalog. Supports 3.0.x and 3.1.x versions.

doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.snippet: Standardized error responses: { error: { code, message, details } }. Custom error classes with status codes. Global error handler formats all responses consistently.

doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.snippet: Services in apps/api/src/services/, plugins in apps/api/src/plugins/, tests in apps/api/src/__tests__/. Fastify plugin pattern for service injection.

doc.title: Epic Definitions
doc.snippet: OpenAPI Spec Validation Service: Validate 3.0.x/3.1.x specs, check required fields, resolve $refs, enforce size limits (10MB, 1000 endpoints).

doc.title: Story 2.1 - Database Schema
doc.snippet: ApiVersion.specJson stores dereferenced OpenAPI spec as JSON. Validation service must return bundled spec (no external $refs) for storage.

artifact.reason: Reference service pattern: class export, constructor with config, JSDoc comments, async methods, error handling with custom statusCode property, uses db from lib/db.js
Reference plugin pattern: use fastify-plugin wrapper, decorate fastify instance with service, TypeScript declaration module augmentation
Main app setup showing plugin registration order, error handler pattern, route registration. New validation plugin should be registered here.
Database client export pattern. New service may not need DB access (stateless validation).
Reference test pattern for services: Vitest describe/it blocks, beforeEach/afterEach setup, service instantiation in tests

node.package: Core web framework - validation service will be injected via plugin
Plugin encapsulation - required for service plugin wrapper
TypeScript JSON Schema - used for request/response validation
Schema validation library - alternative to TypeBox
Test runner - used for unit and integration tests
Database client - though validation service is stateless

toInstall.package: Alternative: OpenAPI validation with bundling support
TypeScript types for swagger-parser if chosen

constraints.constraint: MUST use established validation library (not custom JSON Schema validation)
MUST support both OpenAPI 3.0.x and 3.1.x specifications
MUST follow Fastify plugin pattern for service injection (fastify-plugin wrapper)
MUST provide structured error responses matching architecture error format: { valid, errors: [{ path, message, code }] }
MUST handle edge cases: empty objects, null values, malformed JSON
MUST NOT perform database operations (validation is stateless)
Service files in apps/api/src/services/*.service.ts naming convention
Plugin files in apps/api/src/plugins/*.ts naming convention
Test files in apps/api/src/__tests__/*.test.ts naming convention
Use pnpm for package management (pnpm --filter @perrache/api add ...)
ES modules (type: module in package.json) - use .js extensions in imports

tests.standards: Vitest test runner with TypeScript support. Tests organized by describe blocks for service/component being tested. Use beforeEach/afterEach for setup and teardown. Test files colocated in apps/api/src/__tests__/ directory. Integration tests use app.inject() pattern. Unit tests instantiate services directly with mocked dependencies. Run with: pnpm --filter @perrache/api test

ideas.idea: Test valid OpenAPI 3.0.x spec returns valid: true
Test valid OpenAPI 3.1.x spec returns valid: true
Test missing 'openapi' field returns MISSING_REQUIRED_FIELD error
Test missing 'info.title' field returns MISSING_REQUIRED_FIELD error
Test missing 'info.version' field returns MISSING_REQUIRED_FIELD error

Test valid spec returns dereferenced (bundled) object
Test all $refs are inlined after dereferencing

Test service accessible via fastify.openAPIValidationService after plugin registration
